judgment.notes: N002 supplies preservation by every E_ij; D010 and the N001 basis give E_ij(c e_j)=c e_i and the diagonal coordinate projections. These complex-linear maps are R-linear for R⊂ℂ. The finite-generation image argument has the finite free module and linear maps it requires (BG001). There are no E/M applications.

S001 proves both inclusions J_j⊂J_i and J_i⊂J_j, then uses 0∈I to identify their common value with J. S002 projects each basis coordinate into the image, obtains surjectivity by finite sums, and obtains injectivity by complex basis independence; linearity and the internal direct sum follow. S003 transfers a finite generating family through E_ii and the injective scalar map c↦c e_i. If J=0, S002 makes the image and hence M_R zero, contradicting its complex span V and the nonempty basis. Every clause of N003 follows, including λ=0; no limiting operation occurs.
